# Ayam Labs

> Five focused HTTP APIs on Cloudflare Workers: email verification, on-page SEO audit,
> document text extraction, text analysis and PII redaction. Pay as you go at $0.05 per
> call with no free tier, or monthly plans from $25.

## APIs

- [EmailCheck API](https://labs.ayamk.in/emailcheck.html): syntax, MX DNS, disposable
  domains, role accounts, typo detection and a 0-100 deliverability score.
- [SEO Audit API](https://labs.ayamk.in/seo-audit.html): on-page audit for any URL, titles,
  meta, headings, links, structured data, alt coverage and page weight.
- [DocParse API](https://labs.ayamk.in/docparse.html): clean text from PDF, DOCX and HTML,
  per-page text, metadata and markdown conversion.
- [TextMind API](https://labs.ayamk.in/ai-text.html): sentiment, keywords, entities,
  language detection for free, plus summaries, rewrites, zero-shot labels and translation.
- [PII Shield API](https://labs.ayamk.in/pii-shield.html): find and redact emails, phones,
  cards with Luhn, IBANs with mod-97, IPs, tokens and 13 more detectors.

- [Disposable email domain list](https://labs.ayamk.in/disposable-domains.html): 10,400 domains, free txt and json.

## Guides

- [Email verification without SMTP](https://labs.ayamk.in/guides-email-verification.html)

## Pricing

BASIC pay per use $0.05 per call. PRO $25/month for 25,000 calls. ULTRA $75/month for
100,000. MEGA $150/month for 400,000.
